name: The Café
description: Professional catering and meal prep services in Leavenworth, Kansas. Crafted with care for every occasion.
_comment_social: Public handles. Used by the menu tri-fold and the /studio/ social pieces; the QR art in assets/qr-facebook.svg and assets/qr-website.svg encodes these same two URLs.
_comment_owners: The two names on the door. On the opening post because a small-town reopening is shared for the people, not the premises — friends and family scrolling past recognise a name long before they read an address. Bios and photos are still outstanding: src/team.njk is a placeholder.
_comment_ordering: Square Online, the hosted pickup-ordering site. `url` is the squaresite.com address from square-setup.md §7 in the CafeWork repo, and it is EMPTY UNTIL THAT SITE EXISTS — every Order Online button on this site is conditional on it, so an empty string means no button rather than a button that 404s. A custom domain needs a paid Square plan we deliberately skip, so this will stay an off-domain link; that is a known tradeoff, not an oversight.
_comment_opening: Opening day. Read by the front door banner and the Facebook pieces in /studio/ so the date is stated once. Not billed as a grand opening — the kitchen is still transitioning off the old contract, so the doors open first and a grand opening comes later.
_comment_construction: Set to false to remove the under-construction banner from every page at once.
constructionNotice: Pardon our crumbs. This site is still under construction, so some details may change.
